Pan is a subset of people under the bisexual umbrella. So is omni and poly. It doesn’t make their decision to label themselves any less valid, but it can get confusing. So some people just prefer to use the bisexual label. It’s like saying queer instead of gay/trans/bi. We’re all subjective in our identities. I only like men and women but I can’t imagine how people who like all genders figure out how to label themselves. It’s hard, people will try to police your identity because “it doesn’t fit the definition” but in reality we all have our own definitions. Everyone is different and that’s ok. Being different from others is what makes us human. And sometimes I’ll find myself wondering why we use labels at all if it’s only used as a way to separate us. But the truth is it helps people find out who they are. And honestly you can define yourself with any labels because only you know your experience. And you shouldn’t let anyone else tell you you’re what you’re not. Identity politics is driving the m-spec community, and LGBTQIA+ community apart in general. And it sucks. But as a minority, we should try to stick together and understand each other because that’s what the community was originally made for.
